impact: Outer holdout fold was assigned to val: in Ultralytics fold YAML. Best.pt checkpoint selection was influenced by holdout labels before holdout inference.
solution: Implemented Nested Group-Aware Holdout Isolation (nested_inner_val): Outer holdout fold k is 100% excluded from fold data.yaml. Inner-val is formed from remaining folds to select best.pt; outer holdout is used solely for final OOF prediction.

impact: Evaluators hardcoded cassava-v7-research/valid/images and test/images ignoring CLI flags and data.yaml.
solution: Established validated data.yaml as Single Source of Truth (SSOT). Dynamic resolution of images and labels directories from data.yaml via resolve_val_paths() and resolve_test_paths().

impact: Tie-break order prioritized mAP@50 before Recall Small contrary to locked research protocol.
solution: Locked selection hierarchy in select_best_model(): Primary mAP@50-95 -> Tie-break 1 Recall Small (only if delta mAP <= 1e-5) -> Tie-break 2 mAP@50 -> Tie-break 3 lowest FN. Arbitrary 0.5% margin removed.

impact: Discrepant matching logic across scripts: Stage 8.2 sorted candidates globally while 8.5/8.6 iterated over GT sequentially.
solution: Created canonical greedy_bipartite_matching() in research_utils/detection_metrics.py ensuring identical global candidate descending IoU sorting and zero prediction reuse across all stages.

impact: Images missing from manifest silently fell back to uniform 1/N probability without notifying user.
solution: Implemented strict validate_manifest_coverage() fail-fast check: raises ValueError if any dataset image is missing from manifest or if duplicate image IDs occur.
Updated parse_yolo_labels() to accept dynamic img_width and img_height with square-pixel area calculation.

impact: Recall Small (< 32^2) was omitted from Stage 8.6 test set benchmark report.
solution: Added scale-stratified recall metrics (Small Medium Large) with GT and TP counters.

impact: Skip flags reused existing weights without validating code dataset or parameter checksums.
solution: Added fold_metadata.json and run_metadata in metrics_summary.json storing code SHA-256 data YAML SHA-256 seed batch epochs and hyperparameters. Re-runs if metadata mismatches.

impact: Default output directory pointed to stage_8_ablation risking accidental overwriting of historical results.
solution: Changed clean experiment output default to stage_10_11_clean_experiments and added PermissionError guard preventing accidental writes to stage_8_ablation.

impact: Weak line validation with silent skip on unparseable lines.
solution: Added strict 5-column validation class range [0 4] finite bounds check and verify-only inspection mode.
